author: sam
headline: Added refund endpoint with idempotency keys
summary: Added POST /refunds. The agent first tried client-side dedupe; Sam rejected it because a retry from another device would double-charge, and asked for server-side idempotency keys. Final version requires an Idempotency-Key header and stores processed keys.

decisions.title: Use idempotency keys for refunds
decisions.chosen: Require an Idempotency-Key header; store processed keys and return the stored result on retry.
decisions.reason: Retried refunds from a different device must not double-charge.
